name: Dodopayments — Stripe alternative for non-US founders
description: Stripe alternative built for founders outside the US. Merchants frequently face issues with Stripe cross-border. Has paying customers, launched May 2025.

name: ShareMRR — Marketplace for founders to find growth partners
description: Marketplace where founders list startups with revenue/MRR verified from Stripe. Growth partners browse and request partnerships with commission tracking. FREE for early adopters.

name: Subify — Shopify subscription management app
description: All-in-one subscription management toolkit for Shopify stores. Part of Hengam app studio with 3 apps running. Features: prepay options, discount management, cancellation control, expiration dates. Active paying merchants.

name: DataRaccoon — Chat-based Stripe analytics
description: AI tool to talk to Stripe data — answer questions about MRR, churn, revenue via chat interface. Free trial without credit card. Built by a developer doing payment integrations.

name: Himetrica — SaaS analytics with Stripe integration
description: SaaS analytics tool built by a solo dev. Connects product analytics and revenue in one place. Stripe integration out of the box (MRR, churn, revenue per user). Live in beta with paying customers.

name: Resonly — Prioritize feature requests by revenue impact
description: Feature request prioritization tool that associates revenue with each customer. Shows MRR at risk, MRR lost, and potential MRR from trial customers. Targets SaaS teams.

name: Symswift — Symfony SaaS boilerplate with Stripe
description: Comprehensive Symfony boilerplate with auth, social logins, payments, subscriptions, referral program, ticket system. Includes dashboard for MRR/churn/revenue analytics. Automated Stripe product creation.

name: SongBox — Private audio sharing for creators
description: Alternative to Bandcamp/SoundCloud for private audio sharing. After 2.5 years as a side project, hit £500/month revenue. Solo founder. 647 HN points.

name: TalkNotes — Voice to structured notes with AI
description: Speak freely and AI organizes thoughts into to-do lists, notes, flashcards. Went from $0 to $700 one-time revenue quickly, then pivoted to subscription. Now ~$150 MRR. High churn but growing.

name: codedamn Creator — Build & sell interactive coding courses
description: Platform for developers to create truly interactive in-browser coding courses. Close to $3,000 MRR from in-house courses. Now opening to creators. 0% platform fee.

name: MediaFast — Social media growth tool for founders
description: Tool that helps founders grow on Reddit, X, and LinkedIn. Solo founder Arthur built it after struggling with consistent traffic. Launched June 2025.

name: Videoyards — Web-based Screen Studio for Windows
description: Browser-based screen recording and editing tool. Like Loom + Screen Studio but simpler. Works via Chrome extension. Solo dev project. Launched Oct 2025.

name: ScreenSmooth — Chrome extension for screen recording zooms
description: Chrome extension that automatically adds smart zoom-ins and smooth animations to screen recordings. Made $239 in first 7 days. Solo founder's first SaaS product, launched Feb 2026.

name: Indie10k — AI Coach for indie developers targeting $10k MRR
description: AI-powered coach that guides indie developers to reach $10k MRR. Built because coding projects are fun but turning them into revenue is hard. Launched Sep 2025.

name: AI Contract Analyzer for India — ₹500 legal-tech tool
description: AI-based contract analysis tool targeted at Indian freelancers and SMBs. Built by a student. Most legal-tech products are enterprise-focused and expensive — this is affordable for local market.

name: TheBizness.ai — Marketing channel revenue attribution
description: Solo founder built tool to show which marketing channels actually drive revenue. Connects analytics with actual conversions, not just pageviews. Launched Apr 2025.

name: Donna — Churn detection AI built by non-coder
description: Accidentally built a churn detection AI tool. Non-coder used Claude to turn ideas into code. Started with batch files for automation, evolved into AI SaaS. Aug 2025.

name: changedetection.io — Website change monitoring with SaaS plan
description: Best self-hosted tool for website change detection, price drops, restock alerts. 31,402 stars. Open source with optional paid SaaS plan for managed hosting. Perfect for tracking price changes and restocks.

name: nextjs/saas-starter — Next.js SaaS boilerplate with Stripe
description: Official Next.js starter kit for SaaS with Postgres, Stripe, and shadcn/ui. 15,774 stars. Ready-to-use subscription payments, auth, and dashboard. Production-ready for launching paid SaaS quickly.

name: RuoYi-Vue-Pro — 后台管理系统 SaaS 多租户
description: 基于 Spring Boot + MyBatis Plus + Vue 的全功能后台管理系统。支持 SaaS 多租户、支付、短信、商城、CRM、ERP、AI 大模型等功能。37,014 stars。中国开发者生态热门项目，有商业授权版。

name: ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills — Claude Skills 工具集
description: Curated list of Claude Skills, resources, and tools. 58,961 stars. Composio itself is a SaaS platform for AI agent tooling. Monetized via developer platform.

name: kriasoft/react-starter-kit — Modern SaaS starter with Stripe
description: Modern React starter kit with Bun, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, tRPC, Stripe, and Cloudflare Workers. 23,573 stars. Production-ready monorepo for building fast SaaS web apps.

name: Infracost — Open-source cloud cost estimator
description: Open-source cloud cost estimator for Terraform. YC W21. Shows cost estimates in pull requests. Monetized via team/enterprise plans. 190 HN points.

name: Scaaale — Growth strategies for solopreneurs
description: Platform for solopreneurs and indie hackers with growth strategies, tools, and templates. Comprehensive resource for busy founders. Monetized via templates and tools.

name: Churn Detection AI (Donna) — Non-coder shipped AI SaaS
description: Six months ago discovered Claude could turn ideas into code. Started with batch files, evolved into an AI churn detection SaaS. Story of a non-coder shipping product with AI assistance.
